requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Solution
requirements.Description: Develop HP's first Business Ink Tank printer targeted at SMBs, delivering cost-effective, high-performance printing with a tank system.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses gap in HP's portfolio for CISS PLE Hi segment and competitive leakage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer must utilize ink tank technology, be marketed as HP’s first business tank printer, and achieve targeted cost efficiency.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI features for productivity (Perfect Print/Scan) and device manageability, including workflow automation and support tools.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates Magellan from competitors, addresses SMB needs for efficiency and ease of management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer offers AI-powered print and scan solutions, workflow automation, and management tools accessible to SMB users.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Printer Management
requirements.Description: Provide a consolidated portal specifically designed for SMBs to manage multiple printers, including device status, maintenance, and supplies.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT teams; a portal simplifies management and reduces operational burden.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal enables management of 6-15 printers, supports key device functions, and is user-friendly for office managers/generalist IT.

requirements.Title: Low Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Achieve HP’s lowest business TCO for SMB tank printers through efficient consumables, minimal intervention, and sustainable design.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs prioritize ROI and cost efficiency; competitive advantage over rivals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer demonstrates lowest TCO in HP business tank portfolio, validated by internal/external benchmarks.

requirements.Title: Maintenance-Free or Reduced Maintenance
requirements.Description: Design the printer to require minimal maintenance, with fewer parts to replace over its lifetime and customer-replaceable components.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces SMB operational burden, enhances reliability, and lowers service costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer has fewer replaceable parts than competitors, includes customer-replaceable maintenance box, and meets serviceability targets.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure printer design incorporates at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s sustainability goals and provides a competitive differentiator.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer BOM verified to contain minimum 60% RCP, externally auditable.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever is first), with customer-replaceable components and service center support for major repairs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require reliability and easy servicing; reduces downtime and cost.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation matches requirement; printer supports customer-replaceable parts and service center repairs.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Consumables
requirements.Description: Introduce keyed bottles for ink and other consumables to prevent incorrect refills and ensure compatibility.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user errors, ensures proper functioning, and supports sustainability goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All consumables are keyed and only fit designated printer models; error rate in refilling reduced.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Support and Speed Improvement
requirements.Description: Offer PDL SKU with improved speed (25/20 ppm) and support for PDL/PS printing and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses higher-value business segments, enhances performance, and meets regulatory standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves 25/20 ppm speed, supports PDL/PS, and obtains Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU Solutions
requirements.Description: Support SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal, and enable PaaS for non-PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Expands manageability and solution coverage for SMBs using non-PDL SKU.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU integrates with SMB2.0 Solutions, Advanced View portal, and supports PaaS.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry for device health, usage, and consumables monitoring to support proactive support and analytics.
requirements.Rationale: Enables predictive maintenance, improves customer experience, and supports HP’s service goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer transmits telemetry data securely, supports analytics and proactive support.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing via HP App, supporting SMB workflows and remote management.
requirements.Rationale: Meets modern SMB needs for mobile and flexible printing solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports mobile printing through HP App, verified in field tests.

requirements.Title: Solutions/Services Monetization
requirements.Description: Develop solutions/services that can be monetized, including AI enhancements and PaaS offerings for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Creates new revenue streams and enhances value proposition for SMB customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Solutions/services are available for purchase or subscription, with clear monetization paths.

requirements.Title: Repurpose and Post-Purchase Support
requirements.Description: Design for easy repurposing and post-purchase support, including education, setup, install, registration, and sharing features.
requirements.Rationale: Improves customer satisfaction and extends printer lifecycle.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports repurposing, includes post-purchase support materials, and meets customer satisfaction targets.
